title: find-unit
summary: Finds which indexed unit declares a symbol, and adds that unit to a file's uses clause

surfaces.usage: drag-lint find-unit --name <Symbol> --in <file> [--json|--apply|--no-backup] --db <db> - add the declaring unit to uses

pitfalls: for an RTL/VCL/third-party X, point --db at the PLATFORM LIBRARY database (resolve-dbs --platform win64) -- a project DB holds only that project's units.
